problem: evidence files committed inside a candidate tree cannot contain their own commit/tree hash (self-reference)
convention: I1 evidence head/commit/tree records the source-identical commit whose non-evidence bytes the evidence was generated from
the candidate tree under review must be verified to differ from that source-identical commit only in evidence/current-state files, with all non-evidence bytes equal
the actual candidate commit/tree is bound externally by the I2 review artifact and SUPERVISOR_REVIEW_REQUEST, not by evidence inside the candidate
this convention does not change evidence semantics, authority, or any gate

instance.verified_delta: candidate differs from source-identical commit only in the 7 I1 evidence files (and current-state 03/04/SUPERVISOR updates outside candidate scope)
